why: Macworld, a major reviewer, directly names a best 300W desktop charger, with port splits and price. Notebookcheck tested the 8-port Nexode Pro 300W, but only as a single-product review. The rest are launch news, single reviews, a brand blog, affiliate listicles and one niche comparison whose testing nobody can check. Macworld is Mac-focused and picks the older 5-port model, so a page comparing 8-port 300W stations for several laptops at once could get in, but it would be up against Macworld.
